proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D E hABC hD hE
  have core : ∀ s t : ℝ, (line[ℝ, (AffineMap.lineMap A B s : P), (AffineMap.lineMap A C t : P)]).Parallel line[ℝ, B, C] → s = t := by
    intro s t hpar
    have hli : ∀ a b : ℝ, a • (B -ᵥ A) + b • (C -ᵥ A) = (0 : V) → a = 0 ∧ b = 0 := by
      intro a b h
      by_contra hab
      apply hABC
      rcases not_and_or.mp hab with ha | hb
      · have hB : B -ᵥ A = (-b / a) • (C -ᵥ A) := by
          have h2 : a • (B -ᵥ A) = (-b) • (C -ᵥ A) := by
            rw [neg_smul]; exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h
          rw [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, ← h2, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_smul]
        have h3 := AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair (-b / a) A C
        rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, ← hB, vsub_vadd] at h3
        have h4 := collinear_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair h3
        rwa [Set.insert_comm] at h4
      · have hC : C -ᵥ A = (-a / b) • (B -ᵥ A) := by
          have h2 : b • (C -ᵥ A) = (-a) • (B -ᵥ A) := by
            rw [neg_smul]; exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h
          rw [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, ← h2, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hb, one_smul]
        have h3 := AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair (-a / b) A B
        rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, ← hC, vsub_vadd] at h3
        have h4 := collinear_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair h3
        rwa [Set.insert_comm, Set.pair_comm] at h4
    rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev] at hpar
    have hmem : (AffineMap.lineMap A C t : P) -ᵥ (AffineMap.lineMap A B s : P) ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {C -ᵥ B} := by
      rw [← hpar]; exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
    have hCB : C -ᵥ B = (C -ᵥ A) - (B -ᵥ A) := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C B A).symm
    simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_vadd_cancel_right] at hk
    rw [hCB] at hk
    have h0 : (s - k) • (B -ᵥ A) + (k - t) • (C -ᵥ A) = (0 : V) := by
      have : t • (C -ᵥ A) - s • (B -ᵥ A) - k • ((C -ᵥ A) - (B -ᵥ A)) = (0 : V) := by
        rw [hk]; simp
      rw [← neg_eq_zero, ← this]; module
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hli _ _ h0
    linarith
  have hAB : dist A B ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr hD.left_ne_right
  have hAC : dist A C ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr hE.left_ne_right
  have hDA : D ≠ A := hD.ne_left
  have hDB : D ≠ B := hD.ne_right
  have hEC : E ≠ C := hE.ne_right
  obtain ⟨⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, -, -⟩ := hD
  obtain ⟨⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, -, -⟩ := hE
  have hs1 : s ≠ 1 := by
    rintro rfl; simp at hDB
  have ht1 : t ≠ 1 := by
    rintro rfl; simp at hEC
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl; simp at hDA
  have p1 : 1 - s ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hs1.symm
  have p2 : 1 - t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr ht1.symm
  rw [dist_left_lineMap, dist_left_lineMap, dist_lineMap_right, dist_lineMap_right, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs.1,
    Real.norm_of_nonneg ht.1, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by linarith [hs.2]), Real.norm_of_nonneg (by linarith [ht.2]),
    mul_div_mul_right _ _ hAB, mul_div_mul_right _ _ hAC, div_eq_div_iff p1 p2]
  constructor
  · intro hpar
    have hst := core s t hpar
    rw [hst]
  · intro hprod
    have hst : s = t := by linarith
    subst hst
    rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev]
    have h : (AffineMap.lineMap A C s : P) -ᵥ (AffineMap.lineMap A B s : P) = s • (C -ᵥ B) := by
      simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_vadd_cancel_right]
      rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C B A, smul_sub]
    rw [h]
    exact Submodule.span_singleton_smul_eq (IsUnit.mk0 _ hs0) _
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D E : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → Sbtw ℝ A D B → Sbtw ℝ A E C → ((line[ℝ, D, E]).Parallel line[ℝ, B, C] ↔ dist A D / dist D B = dist A E / dist E C)
